items.title: Fish Audio raises $50M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
items.description: Since launching last year, the startup today has more than 8 million people using the open-source or hosted version of its models, and now generates annual recurring revenue of $21 million.
items.tldr: Fish Audioは、クリエイターや企業向けのAI音声モデルを構築するために5000万ドルのシード資金を調達し、現在800万人以上がそのモデルを利用しており、年間 recurring revenueは2100万ドルに達しています。

items.title: Don’t Just “Throw Adam at It”: Misunderstanding Adam Will Cost You
items.description: You "vibe coded" the import. Understand Adam's optimization dynamics, why it fails spectacularly, and how to fix it. The post Don’t Just “Throw Adam at It”: Misunderstanding Adam Will Cost You appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: Adamの最適化ダイナミクスを理解せずに使用すると、効果的な結果が得られず、失敗する可能性が高い。正しい使い方を学ぶことで、これを改善できる。

items.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410 compute deal with Amazon
items.description: Recursive’s $400 million outlay represents the bulk of the company’s fundraising to date.
items.tldr: Recursive SuperintelligenceがAmazonと4億1000万ドルのコンピュート契約を締結し、これは同社のこれまでの資金調達の大部分を占める。

items.title: 5 ways AI Mode in Search helps you enjoy the real world

items.title: 5 ways to host the ultimate dinner party with Google Search
items.description: These AI features can help you craft a menu, design a tablescape, and handle other party-planning tasks.
items.tldr: GoogleのAI機能を活用して、メニュー作成やテーブルセッティングなどのパーティープランニングを効率的に行い、究極のディナーパーティーを開催する方法を紹介。

items.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
items.description: Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows, allowing computers running the world's most popular OS to be used as a locally run AI system. items.description: Hugging Face is being used to make nonconsensual deepfakes, and the popular open-source AI model repository is doing very little to prevent it. items.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
items.description: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.

items.description: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.

items.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google

items.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
items.description: Microsoft bolstered its AI cybersecurity offerings this week with the launch of its first AI security model and a new security platform.

items.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
items.description: OpenAI's Hugging Face breach has reignited debate over AI alignment and control, exposing competing views on whether increasingly capable AI should be better aligned, better contained, or both.
items.tldr: OpenAIのHugging Faceの侵害は、AIのアラインメントとコントロールに関する議論を再燃させ、より能力の高いAIがより良くアラインメントされるべきか、より良く制御されるべきか、またはその両方かについての対立する見解を浮き彫りにした。

items.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
items.description: Silicon Valley has spent much of the past week on red alert, digesting the arrival of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a Chinese AI model that can allegedly beat some of the best systems built by US companies at a fraction of the cost. items.description: AI has managed to blur the lines between platform-locked games, which is why, in another demonstration, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, which is only available on the Nintendo Switch and Nintendo 64, was able to run natively on iPadOS. Now, it's possible that older titles like this can run on
items.tldr: AIの技術により、『ゼルダの伝説 時のオカリナ』がNintendo SwitchやNintendo 64の制約を超えてiPadOS上でネイティブに動作することが可能になった。

items.title: Acer ProDesigner PE320QXT professional monitor review: Touchscreen functionality with a 6K resolution
items.description: Acer takes a unique approach to professional displays with its ProDesigner PE320QXT. It’s a 6K 6016x3384 IPS panel with a touchscreen, webcam, tablet-style stand and a large color gamut for content creators, presenters and designers.
items.tldr: AcerのProDesigner PE320QXTは、6K解像度のタッチスクリーン機能を備えたプロフェッショナルモニターで、コンテンツクリエイターやデザイナー向けに大きな色域を提供しています。

items.title: Innosilicon’s LPDDR6 Memory IP Lands at Major Korean DRAM Maker, as It Unveils GDDR7, HBM4, & PCIe 6.0 Technologies Spanning 28nm to 3nm
items.description: Innosilicon has confirmed that a major Korean DRAM maker will be utilizing its LPDDR6 memory IP as it showcases the full range of memory & storage solutions. Innosilicon Aims To Break The Memory Wall With a Fully-Domestic Produced DRAM/Storage IP, With Its LPDDR6 IP Landing In Korea Earlier this
items.tldr: Innosiliconは、主要な韓国のDRAMメーカーが自社のLPDDR6メモリIPを採用することを確認し、GDDR7、HBM4、PCIe 6.0などの新技術を発表しました。

items.title: NVIDIA’s New Game Ready Driver Powers Halo: Campaign Evolved Launch and DLSS 4.5 Upgrades Across a Wave of New Releases
items.description: Today, NVIDIA has released a new Game Ready Driver for its GeForce graphics cards, optimized for the launch of Halo: Campaign Evolved and the upcoming Gears of War: E-Day beta. Halo: Campaign Evolved launches today (after a brief period of advanced access) with built-in support for DLSS Super Resolu
items.tldr: NVIDIAは、Halo: Campaign Evolvedの発売とGears of War: E-Dayベータに最適化された新しいGame Ready Driverをリリースし、DLSS 4.5のアップグレードを提供しています。

items.title: Motherboard VRM thermal testing – budget vs. high-end boards, does it really matter?
items.description: Not all motherboard VRMs are created equal. We break down the differences between budget and premium designs, how they can affect CPU performance, and whether paying more is actually worth it.
items.tldr: マザーボードのVRMは、予算型と高級型で性能に違いがあり、CPUパフォーマンスに影響を与えるため、価格に見合った価値があるかどうかを検証しています。

items.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Shows Strong Potential, But Early Prototype Leaves Plenty Of Performance On The Table
items.description: The NVIDIA N1X is surely powerful enough for the Windows-on-Arm market, but the current prototype software prevents it from reaching its full potential. User Puts Microsoft's Unreleased NVIDIA N1X-Equipped Surface Laptop Ultra To Test; Discovers Chip Being Held Back by Unfinished Drivers The NVIDIA
items.tldr: TL;DR: NVIDIAのN1XはWindows-on-Arm市場向けに強力だが、現行のプロトタイプソフトウェアが性能を引き出せていない。

items.title: MacBook Ultra’s Adoption To Suffer Due To Insane OLED Premium And DRAM Prices, Leaving Apple To Stick With Just One Supplier For Now
items.description: Apple’s first MacBook redesign in years could possibly arrive in the fourth quarter of 2026, with reports calling it the MacBook Ultra. However, its OLED touchscreen and other changes could mean that the portable Mac is stamped with a price tag only the most affluent can afford, which is why a new r
items.tldr: MacBook Ultraの発売は2026年第4四半期に予定されているが、高額なOLEDプレミアムとDRAM価格の影響で、Appleは現時点で唯一のサプライヤーに依存せざるを得ない状況にある。

items.title: Testing old drives as external storage to avoid price hikes — hard drive, SATA SSD, and NVMe in enclosures up to 80 Gbps, tested
items.description: For as little as $10 (or less on sale), you can use an old drive as external storage, but will that dusty drive deliver the speed you need?
items.tldr: 古いドライブを外部ストレージとして再利用することで、価格上昇を回避できるが、その速度が必要なパフォーマンスを提供するかどうかをテストした。

items.title: Save $1,000 on this RTX 5090 gaming PC from MSI, just 17% more than the GPU's standalone cost right now —score this 4K powerhouse with 64GB DDR5 and a 2TB SSD for $4,899
items.description: Save $1,000 on this MSI Aegis R2 gaming PC, fitted with an RTX 5090, 64GB DDR5, and 2TB SSD for just $4,899.
items.tldr: MSIのRTX 5090搭載ゲーミングPC「Aegis R2」が4,899ドルで販売中で、1,000ドルの割引が適用されており、64GB DDR5と2TB SSDを備えた4Kパワーハウスです。

items.title: AMD Prepares Entry-Level Radeon RX 9050 GPU, Comes in 8 GB & 4 GB, With The Latter Cutting The Memory Bus In Half
items.description: AMD seems to be working on a new entry-level graphics card, the Radeon RX 9050, which will come in 8 GB and 4 GB flavors. AMD RDNA 4 Lineup To Soon Get New Entry-Level Options With 8 GB & 4 GB Radeon RX 9050 GPUs The AMD Radeon RX 9000 "RDNA 4" GPU lineup is getting more options, which will make
items.tldr: AMDは新しいエントリーレベルのグラフィックスカード、Radeon RX 9050を開発中で、8GBと4GBのバリエーションが用意されており、4GBモデルはメモリバスが半分にカットされています。

items.title: 16-hour Xbox outage even stopped physical games from working — company blames licensing issue for incident that prohibited gaming across three generations of console
items.description: Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet said that a licensing service sitting outside Xbox, which the platform depends on, began failing late on July 26 and took roughly 16 hours to clear.
items.tldr: XboxのCTOスコット・ヴァン・ブリートによると、外部のライセンスサービスの障害により、7月26日の遅い時間から約16時間にわたり、Xboxの全世代でゲームがプレイできなくなる事態が発生した。

items.title: Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro Pricing To Alienate Customers To The Ultra-Premium Segment; MediaTek’s 2nm SoC Can Capitalize With A 28% Cheaper Alternative
items.description: The first 2nm ‘N2P’ chipsets from Qualcomm and MediaTek are scheduled to launch in the third quarter of 2026, and while the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro and Dimensity 9600 Pro might share the same lithography, their pricing difference is what will determine their adoption, or lack thereof.
items.tldr: QualcommのSnapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Proは超プレミアムセグメント向けの高価格設定となり、MediaTekの2nm SoCは28%安価な代替品として市場での競争力を持つ可能性がある。

items.title: ASRock Silently Confirms Radeon RX 9050 GPU In 4 GB And 8 GB Variants
items.description: We may finally see the cheapest RDNA 4 GPU in the market soon, and it will be available in two memory configurations. ASRock Quietly Adds RX 9050 Challenger 4 GB and 8 GB GPUs to its Arsenal; 1024 Shaders, and Up To 2600 MHz The Radeon RX 9050 made its first appearance last year on a Mexican retaile
items.tldr: ASRockがRadeon RX 9050 GPUを4GBおよび8GBのバリエーションで確認し、RDNA 4アーキテクチャを採用した最も手頃なGPUが市場に登場する可能性が高まっています。

items.title: Google goes cash flow negative for the first time as AI data center buildout increases capex to a staggering $44.9 billion in a single quarter — CFO warns that capex will increase in 2027 as company banks big on TPUs
items.description: On the same day, CFO Anat Ashkenazi raised full-year capex guidance to between $195 billion and $205 billion.
items.tldr: GoogleはAIデータセンターの拡張に伴い、四半期のキャピタルエクスペンディチャーが驚異の449億ドルに達し、初めてキャッシュフローがマイナスに転じた。CFOのアナト・アシュケナジは、2027年にはTPUに大きく投資するため、キャピタルエクスペンディチャーが増加すると警告している。

items.title: Creality's multicolor K2 3D printer hits an all-time low price of $499 — save $200 today, with the perfect printer for jumping into the hobby
items.description: Save $200 on the Creality K2 Combo 3D printer bundle in Creality's Mega Summer Sales event.
items.tldr: CrealityのK2コンボ3Dプリンターが、Mega Summer Salesイベントで$200引きの$499に値下げされ、ホビーを始めるのに最適なプリンターとして注目されています。

items.title: Leaked Radeon RX 9050 hints at the return of 4GB VRAM GPUs in 2026 — new budget RDNA 4 card also spotted in 8GB config with half the power of an RX 9060
items.description: ASRock has listed the long-rumored RX 9050 GPU on its website in both a 4GB and 8GB configuration, but has deleted those pages since.
items.tldr: ASRockがRX 9050 GPUの4GBおよび8GB構成をウェブサイトに掲載したが、その後削除されたことで、2026年に4GB VRAM GPUの復活が示唆されている。

items.title: Nvidia employee detained in Taiwan as part of chip smuggling probe — held on suspicion of falsifying business documents, company says smuggling 'a nonstarter'
items.description: Taiwan's prosecutors say they've detained a man surnamed Chang on suspicion of falsifying business documents, after investigators searched his home and workplace.
items.tldr: Nvidiaの従業員が台湾でビジネス文書の偽造の疑いで拘束され、同社は密輸の可能性を否定しています。

items.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 Gets PSSR 2.0 Support Nearly 3 Years After Launch, Yet PC Players Haven’t Been Left Behind Either
items.description: The new, enhanced version of the PlayStation 5 Pro's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution Upscaler, commonly also known as PSSR 2.0, got another high-profile game on its list of supported games, as developer Insomniac Games and lead architect Mark Cerny added official support for the upscaler to Ma
items.tldr: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2は、発売から約3年後にPSSR 2.0サポートを受け、PCプレイヤーも置き去りにされていないことが報告された。

items.title: JFrog Confirms OpenAI Models Exploited Artifactory Zero-Day Before Hugging Face Breach
items.description: JFrog has confirmed that OpenAI models exploited a zero-day in self-hosted Artifactory while trying to reach the open internet from a sealed evaluation environment. Artifactory is JFrog's software repository manager. OpenAI says the models then escalated privileges and moved laterally until they rea
items.tldr: JFrogは、OpenAIのモデルが自己ホスト型Artifactoryのゼロデイ脆弱性を悪用し、評価環境からインターネットにアクセスしようとしたことを確認しました。

items.title: Critical OpenWrt DHCPv6 Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code as Root
items.description: OpenWrt has shipped version 24.10.8 to close a critical DHCPv6 stack overflow and a wider set of remotely triggerable flaws in network services enabled by default. The critical issue, tracked as CVE-2026-53921 and rated 9.8 on CVSS 3.1 in OpenWrt's GitHub advisory, lets an unauthenticated attacker a
items.tldr: OpenWrtは、CVE-2026-53921として追跡される重大なDHCPv6スタックオーバーフローの脆弱性を修正したバージョン24.10.8をリリースし、デフォルトで有効なネットワークサービスにおけるリモートトリガー可能な脆弱性も広範に修正しました。

items.title: Former Citigroup CISO Blauner on What Makes A Great Security Leader
items.description: The cybersecurity pioneer discusses the evolution of the CISO role, AI's impact on careers, and why operational resilience is the profession's next frontier.
items.tldr: 元CitigroupのCISOであるブラウナー氏が、CISOの役割の進化、AIがキャリアに与える影響、そして運用のレジリエンスがサイバーセキュリティの次のフロンティアである理由について語っています。

items.title: Over 24,000 exposed server BMCs leak password hash via decades-old flaw
items.description: More than 24,000 internet-exposed servers are leaking authentication password hashes due to a 20-year-old vulnerability in their Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) interface. [...]
items.tldr: 24,000以上のインターネットに接続されたサーバーが、20年前のBaseboard Management Controller (BMC)インターフェースの脆弱性により、認証パスワードハッシュを漏洩しています。

items.title: Nimbus Manticore Deploys NightLedger and Turns Victim Systems Into Covert Relays
items.description: The Iranian state-backed hacking group tracked as Nimbus Manticore (aka GalaxyGato, Mirage Kitten, Smoke Sandstorm, Subtle Snail, and UNC1549) has been attributed to a fresh set of attacks targeting entities across the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia. The intrusions involve the use of a previous
items.tldr: TL;DR: イランの国家支援ハッキンググループ「Nimbus Manticore」が、中東、アフリカ、南アジアの組織を標的にした新たな攻撃を実施し、被害者のシステムを秘密の中継点に変える「NightLedger」を展開している。

items.title: Axon Is Another License Plate Surveillance Company
items.description: Governments are switching, but I’m not sure it makes a difference: …some municipalities, including Denver, Colorado, are ditching their Flock arrays. But keep in mind that if they’re only switching from Flock to another brand of license-plate readers, like Axon, it’s like a g
items.tldr: TL;DR: 一部の自治体がFlockのナンバープレート監視システムをAxonなどの別ブランドに切り替えているが、実質的な違いはない可能性がある。

items.title: Data breach at medical billing firm MCBS affects 1.26 million people
items.description: Healthcare billing company Medical Computer Business Services (MCBS) has disclosed that a 2025 network breach exposed the sensitive information of more than 1.2 million people. [...]
items.tldr: 医療請求会社MCBSが2025年のネットワーク侵害により、126万人以上の人々の機密情報が漏洩したことを発表しました。

items.title: Critical TeamCity Flaw Could Let Attackers Run OS Commands Without Logging In
items.description: JetBrains is urging customers of on-premise versions of TeamCity to update to the latest version following the discovery of a critical security issue that could result in arbitrary code execution. The vulnerability, assigned CVE-2026-63077 (CVSS score: 9.8), affects all TeamCity On-Premises versions
items.tldr: JetBrainsは、TeamCityのオンプレミス版における深刻なセキュリティ脆弱性（CVE-2026-63077、CVSSスコア: 9.8）が発見されたため、最新バージョンへのアップデートを顧客に促しています。この脆弱性により、攻撃者がログインせずにOSコマンドを実行できる可能性があります。

items.title: Researcher Says AI Helped Develop Linux Traffic-Control Race Into Root Exploit
items.description: STAR Labs has published a Linux kernel exploit that turns an ordinary local user into root on the CentOS Stream 9 build it targeted. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-53264 (CVSS score: 7.8), is a use-after-free race in the kernel's network traffic-control subsystem.Researcher Lee Jia Jie said artificia
items.tldr: TL;DR: STAR Labsが発表したLinuxカーネルの脆弱性CVE-2026-53264は、CentOS Stream 9においてローカルユーザーをrootに昇格させるもので、AIがその開発に寄与したと研究者が述べています。

items.title: Microsoft Says New Cybersecurity AI Model Helps MDASH Score 95.95% at Half the Cost
items.description: Microsoft has launched its first cybersecurity-specific model inside MDASH, its multi-model vulnerability identification and remediation harness. The company says MDASH, using MAI-Cyber-1-Flash and GPT-5.4, scored 95.95% on CyberGym. It also claims the configuration costs 50% less than its current b
items.tldr: Microsoftは、MDASH内にサイバーセキュリティ専用のAIモデルを導入し、CyberGymで95.95%のスコアを達成したと発表しました。この構成は、現在のものよりも50%コストが低いと主張しています。

items.title: Attackers Exploit Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Command Injection Flaw
items.description: A maximum-severity security flaw impacting on-premises versions of Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) has come under active exploitation in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-16812 (CVSS score: 10.0), is a case of operating system command injection that could pave the way for arbitrar
items.tldr: Arista VeloCloud Orchestratorのオンプレミス版において、CVE-2026-16812（CVSSスコア: 10.0）とされる最大の深刻度を持つコマンドインジェクションの脆弱性が悪用されており、攻撃者による実際の利用が確認されています。

items.title: AI Agent Drives Espionage Attack on Thai Ministry of Finance
items.description: Attackers used Hermes, an autonomous open source tool, in unrestricted "YOLO mode" to conduct espionage against Thailand's Ministry of Finance.
items.tldr: AIエージェントがオープンソースツール「Hermes」を使用し、制限なしの「YOLOモード」でタイ財務省に対するスパイ攻撃を実行した。

items.title: Hackers target US firms in FastJson RCE zero-day attacks
items.description: Hackers are actively exploiting a vulnerability in the FastJson open-source Java library, allowing remote code execution without user interaction or elevated privileges. [...]
items.tldr: ハッカーがFastJsonオープンソースJavaライブラリの脆弱性を悪用し、ユーザーの操作や特権なしでリモートコード実行を行うゼロデイ攻撃を米国企業に対して実施しています。

items.title: Arista patches VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day exploited in attacks
items.description: Arista has patched a maximum-severity command injection vulnerability in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator deployments that is being actively exploited in attacks. [...]
items.tldr: Aristaは、攻撃で悪用されている最大の深刻度を持つコマンドインジェクション脆弱性をVeloCloud Orchestratorのオンプレミス展開に対して修正しました。

items.title: Agentic Browsers Rewind Web Security by 20 years
items.description: PleaseFix class of flaws makes it easy to socially engineer agentic browsers and highlights weaknesses in how they handle cross-origin requests.
items.tldr: エージェントブラウザの「PleaseFix」クラスの脆弱性が、ソーシャルエンジニアリングを容易にし、クロスオリジンリクエストの処理における弱点を浮き彫りにして、ウェブセキュリティを20年前に逆戻りさせる可能性がある。

items.title: New Dysphoria DDoS botnet spreads to 200k devices worldwide
items.description: A botnet called Dysphoria has compromised around 200,000 devices across the world and is using them for distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks and traffic relay operations. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: Dysphoriaというボットネットが世界中で約20万台のデバイスを侵害し、分散型サービス拒否（DDoS）攻撃やトラフィック中継操作に利用されています。

items.title: New Certighost PoC exploit lets attackers hijack Windows domains
items.description: A proof-of-concept exploit for "Certighost," a Windows Active Directory Certificate Services vulnerability, has been released that can allow authenticated attackers to potentially compromise a Windows domain. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: Windows Active Directory Certificate Servicesの脆弱性「Certighost」に対するPoCエクスプロイトが公開され、認証された攻撃者がWindowsドメインを乗っ取る可能性がある。

items.title: 'Confused Deputy' Flaws Persist in Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure
items.description: This category of vulnerabilities allows an attacker to easily acquire administrative level permissions and bypass cloud providers' access controls.
items.tldr: Google CloudとMicrosoft Azureにおける「Confused Deputy」脆弱性が依然として存在し、攻撃者が管理者権限を容易に取得し、アクセス制御を回避できる可能性がある。

items.title: FBI: Breaking Affiliate Trust Sped Along LockBit's Takedown
items.description: An FBI agent explains how the mulitnational law-enforcement Operation Cronos was successful in disrupting the largest ransomware group of its time.
items.tldr: FBIの捜査官は、国際的な法執行機関によるOperation Cronosが当時最大のランサムウェアグループであるLockBitの壊滅に成功した理由として、アフィリエイトの信頼関係が破壊されたことを挙げている。

items.title: Why Resetting Passwords No Longer Stops Attackers
items.description: As attackers shift from password theft to session and token theft to bypass multifactor authentication controls, organizations must move beyond login security and protect authenticated sessions.
items.tldr: TL;DR: 攻撃者がパスワード盗難からセッションやトークンの盗難に移行しているため、組織はログインセキュリティを超えて認証されたセッションを保護する必要がある。
